title: New inquiry ack
body: Thanks for contacting {{CLIENT_BUSINESS_NAME}}. We have your request and will review it during business hours.

title: Ask for details
body: Thanks — could you share a bit more about whether this is Automation, Websites, Branding, or Systems work?

title: Booking offer
body: If you would rather talk it through, you can choose a time on our calendar. A form request is not a reserved appointment.

title: After hours
body: Thanks for writing. Our team reviews requests during business hours (US/Eastern). We will follow up using the contact method you provided.

title: Human handoff
body: I will pass this to the {{CLIENT_BUSINESS_NAME}} team so a person can help with your question.

title: No pricing on chat
body: Scope, pricing, and availability are confirmed by the team after we review your request. I do not quote a number here.

title: STOP received
body: You are opted out of texts from {{CLIENT_BUSINESS_NAME}}. We will not send further marketing or service texts to this number.

title: Estimate follow-up
body: Checking in on the estimate we sent. If you have questions about scope or next steps, reply here. Any price change will be confirmed by our team.

title: Thank you / won
body: Thank you for choosing {{CLIENT_BUSINESS_NAME}}. Our team will confirm the next steps for your service.

title: Review invite
body: If you would like to share an honest public review of your experience, I can send the review link. There is no pressure either way.

title: Emergency deflect
body: If this is an emergency or someone is in danger, please contact local emergency services. {{CLIENT_BUSINESS_NAME}} cannot replace 911.

title: Existing customer support
body: Thanks — I will treat this as a support request for an existing project rather than a new sales inquiry.
